title: Battle of Kamalpur
subtitle: Repeated frontier attacks test Pakistani defenses in the northern sector.
summary: The Battle of Kamalpur involved repeated Mukti Bahini assaults against a fortified Pakistani position near the border. It became a symbol of persistent guerrilla and conventional pressure during the Liberation War.
heroTagline: Repeated frontier attacks test Pakistani defenses in the northern sector.
whyItMatters: Kamalpur helps show the war as a sequence of sector-level battles, not only national milestones.
